law_record.title: Bus parking, loading and unloading (A)(1)
law_record.text: The operator of a bus, other than a tour bus, shall: Not stand or park such vehicle upon any street at any place other than a bus stop, bus stand or the origin or destination point for the route to which such vehicle is assigned which has been designated in accordance with Section 11.60.010 [DEF-LVMC-11-60-010] of this Chapter.

activation_conditions: the subject operates a bus other than a tour bus
the bus stands or parks on a street at a place that is not a designated bus stop, bus stand, or its route's origin or destination point
residue: the route's designated origin or destination point is an administrative designation the cited provision carries, not a scene fact
summary.subject: bus_operator

timing_requirements.requirement: judged for every instant the bus stands
standing is distinguished from a traffic halt by the drv.standing_or_parked duration parameter
